seowatcher, Google Search Console, Googl: seowatcher is a free, MIT-licensed SEO app that shows Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, its own site crawler and PageSpeed Insights in one panel. It installs on Windows 10 and 11 from a single file and runs with Docker on Mac and Linux; your data stays on your computer. Its GitHub repository is called seotracker.

Windows \"tanınmayan uygulama\" uyarısı: Windows says it protected my PC. Is the installer safe?
Kurulum dosyası henüz kod imzalı değil,: The installer is not code-signed yet, which is why Windows warns you. On the SmartScreen screen click "More info", then "Run anyway". The file's fingerprint (SHA-256) is printed on every release page; compare it if you like. <a class="textlink" href="/docs/sorun-giderme/" >Troubleshooting</a >.
<code>%LOCALAPPDATA%\\seowatcher</code>: In the %LOCALAPPDATA%\seowatcher folder. The database, your Google access key and the logs are there. Uninstalling the app leaves this folder alone; to make a backup, just copy it.
Neden Google'da bir erişim anahtarı oluş: Why do I have to create an access key at Google?
seowatcher bir bulut hizmeti değil; bilg: seowatcher is not a cloud service; it runs on your computer and connects to Google directly. Google wants to know who owns the app that is connecting. You do this once, and the app shows the steps on screen.
Sayılar Search Console'dakiyle aynı mı?: Are the numbers the same as in Search Console?
Aynı kaynaktan okunur, ama toplamlar bir: They come from the same source, but the totals may not match. Google delivers data about three days late and hides rarely searched queries. The app shows the page total and the site total separately; the two differing is not a bug.
Sitemi internete açmadan kullanabilir mi: Can I use it without exposing my site to the internet?
Evet, zaten öyle çalışır. Uygulama yalnı: Yes, that is how it already works. The app opens only from your own computer and reads Search Console and Analytics data from Google. During an audit it crawls only the pages of the site you are auditing.
